resources.string: The copy of this file is not on this device any more. Choose the file again.
The copy is made. It is kept when you save the connection.
This database uses WAL mode. Only the main file is copied, so changes that still sit in its -wal file are not in the copy. Close the database in the app that wrote it, then choose it again.
The original can only be read again while Android still allows it. If this is greyed out, choose the file again.
The copy is replaced by the original as it is now. Any change you made to the copy in this app is lost.
Opened read-only: nothing can change the copy.
Writable: changes go into the app\'s copy of the file. They are never written back to the original.
That is not a SQLite database. It may be encrypted, or another kind of file.
The file could not be copied: %1$s
